# IStakingReceiver
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IStakingReceiver.sol)

**Title:**
IStakingReceiver

Interface a contract must implement to receive tokens from `withdrawToAndCall`


## Functions
### onWithdrawReceived

Called by the staking contract after transferring withdrawn tokens to this receiver


```solidity
function onWithdrawReceived(
    IERC20 token,
    address from,
    uint256 value,
    bytes calldata data
)
    external
    returns (bytes4);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The staking token withdrawn|
|`from`|`address`|The account the tokens were withdrawn from|
|`value`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens received|
|`data`|`bytes`|Arbitrary data forwarded from the caller|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes4`|The function selector confirming receipt (magic value)|
